title: Half Dome via the Mist Trail
map_label: A 3D walk from Happy Isles up past Vernal and Nevada Falls to the Half Dome cables and summit.

stops.file: Happy Isles Bridge - Yosemite National Park, California, USA (27672490762).jpg
stops.title: Happy Isles Trailhead
stops.alt: The Merced River rushing below the Happy Isles bridge.
stops.text: The route starts here at the valley floor, about 4,000 feet up. Follow the Mist Trail toward Half Dome.

stops.file: Sub DOme Approach to Half Dome Cables.jpg
stops.title: Sub Dome
stops.alt: Half Dome rising above the granite of Sub Dome, with the cables running up its face.
stops.text: After Little Yosemite Valley the trail climbs the granite of Sub Dome. The cables are visible on the face ahead.

stops.title: Half Dome Summit
stops.alt: Hikers gather on the edge of the Half Dome summit above Tenaya Canyon.
stops.text: You have reached the summit of Half Dome, about 4,800 feet above where you started. The final stretch climbs the cables.
